guide.name: Google Ads API list upload (Customer Match)

claims.text: The Google Ads API list upload for Customer Match is performed through the Customer Match section of the Google Ads API.
conditions: Describes the API upload path; Google recommends Data Manager or the Data Manager API for new Customer Match integrations.

claims.text: The same API section is used both to upload data files and to manage audiences.
Use of the API upload is restricted to account owners or administrators.

evidence.locator: Account owners or administrators can use the Customer Match section of the Google Ads API

conditions: Access condition stated for the API upload path.

claims.text: Data files are uploaded via the Customer Match section of the Google Ads API, and audiences can be managed through the same section.
The upload is an advertiser-controlled action (the account owner or administrator initiates uploads and audience management), not an automatic or reporting-only process.
conditions: Editorial inference from the documented upload/manage actions; the packet does not use control/signal terminology.

claims.text: How uploaded data is matched to users (for example hashing or match-rate calculation) is not described in the packet.
The API upload is used to upload Customer Match data files and manage audiences.
For new Customer Match integrations, Google recommends using Data Manager or the Data Manager API rather than the Google Ads API.

evidence.locator: It's recommended that you avoid using the Google Ads API for new Customer Match integrations

conditions: Scoped to new integrations; the packet states no deadline or deprecation date for the API path.

claims.text: The API upload path is therefore best understood as serving integrations that already exist, with Data Manager or the Data Manager API as the recommended route for new ones.

evidence.locator: It's recommended that you avoid using the Google Ads API for new Customer Match integrations

conditions: Editorial inference from the recommendation; the packet does not explicitly label the API path as legacy or deprecated.

claims.text: Only account owners or administrators can use the API upload.

evidence.locator: Account owners or administrators can use the Customer Match section of the Google Ads API

claims.text: The upload and audience management take place in the Customer Match section of the Google Ads API.

Step-by-step setup instructions (such as API client configuration, authentication, or the exact upload request format) are not documented in the packet, so the setup path stops at the access prerequisite.
